title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
summary: The briefing is supported by the roadmap, the supplied Microsoft notice and Microsoft Learn. It accurately distinguishes automatic policy migration from parameter defaults and reports the documentation disagreements. The transcription control path should finish at the Transcription toggle.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: MeetingAI controls availability of Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap and other meeting AI features.
claims.quote: MeetingAI - controls whether Copilot, Facilitator, Intelligent Recap, and other AI features are available in meetings.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI controls automatic transcription when meeting AI is turned on.
claims.quote: TranscriptionWithMeetingAI - controls whether transcription starts automatically when meeting AI is turned on.

claims.claim: The existing Copilot policy combines AI availability with whether a saved transcript is required.
claims.quote: Today, the Copilot policy combines whether AI is available in a meeting with whether a saved transcript is required.

claims.claim: The replacement model adds the ability to enforce Copilot off.
claims.quote: including the ability to enforce Copilot off.

claims.claim: The replacement controls arrive automatically without administrator action, represented by defaultState on.
claims.quote: No admin action is required to migrate existing configurations. ... Existing configurations will be mapped automatically.

claims.claim: Microsoft performs a one-time mapping of each existing Copilot value to the two replacement policy values.
claims.quote: Microsoft will perform a one-time update mapping each existing Copilot value to the corresponding MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values

claims.where: What's changing; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The mapping preserves current effective behavior rather than resetting existing policies to parameter defaults.
claims.quote: preserving the current effective behavior for your organization.

claims.claim: Administrators do not need to recreate existing meeting policies.
claims.quote: Administrators do not need to recreate their policies.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride as the MeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote: ### -MeetingAI ... | Default value: | EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride |

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference gives EnabledNoOverride as the TranscriptionWithMeetingAI parameter default.
claims.quote: ### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI ... | Default value: | EnabledNoOverride |

claims.claim: The reference says MeetingAI is not fully released and has no effect yet.
claims.quote: ### -MeetingAI ... This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The reference says TranscriptionWithMeetingAI is not fully released and has no effect yet.
claims.quote: ### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI ... This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: The planned settings appear in Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI.
claims.quote: The new settings will appear in the Teams admin center meeting policy under Recording and transcription and Copilot and other AI:

claims.claim: The notice lists Allow AI in meetings values On, Off but organizers can change, and Off and organizers cannot change.
claims.quote: Allow AI in meetings: On / Off, but organizers can change / Off, and organizers cannot change

claims.claim: The notice lists Start transcription when AI is turned on values On but organizers can change, On and organizers cannot change, and Off.
claims.quote: Start transcription when AI is turned on: On, but organizers can change / On, and organizers cannot change / Off

claims.claim: The existing Transcription policy remains and controls whether transcription is allowed.
claims.quote: The Transcription policy remains available and continues to control whether transcription is allowed.

claims.claim: Who can manage AI replaces the Allow Copilot and Facilitator meeting option.
claims.quote: Who can manage AI - replaces the existing Allow Copilot and Facilitator option

claims.claim: Who can manage AI determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.
claims.quote: determines who can turn Copilot and other AI features on or off during a meeting.

claims.claim: The notice says Who can manage AI becomes No one if an admin turns Meeting AI off.
claims.quote: If an admin turns Meeting AI off, this option is set to No one.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Who can use AI provides organizers granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.
claims.quote: Who can use AI - provides more granular control over which meeting participants can use Copilot and other AI capabilities.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Start Transcription with AI lets organizers choose per meeting whether transcription starts with AI.
claims.quote: Start Transcription with AI - lets organizers choose whether transcription starts with AI.

claims.claim: Administrators can also control Start Transcription with AI through Teams admin center.
claims.quote: Administrators can also control this option through Teams admin center.

claims.claim: New organizer Intelligent Recap controls determine whether a recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including without a transcript.
claims.quote: Intelligent Recap controls - lets organizers decide whether an Intelligent Recap is created when Copilot is turned on, including for meetings where a transcript is not created.

claims.quote: Once the new controls are enabled, the Copilot policy can no longer be updated directly - attempts will return guidance to use the new policies.

claims.claim: The notice says the change does not alter processing or storage of existing customer data.
claims.quote: does not alter how existing customer data is processed or stored.

claims.claim: Where the transcription-with-AI setting permits organizer changes, the organizer can decide whether transcription starts.
claims.quote: Start transcription when AI is turned on: On, but organizers can change / On, and organizers cannot change / Off

claims.claim: With Allow AI in all meetings Off, no real-time transcript is available through Work IQ regardless of the Work IQ access setting.
claims.quote: | Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |

claims.claim: The supplied notice describes no change to identity, permissions or administrator roles.
claims.quote: Searched: read supplied MC1532253 in full for identity, permissions and role changes; none described.

claims.claim: Teams Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and associated PowerShell controls.
claims.quote: Everything in the Microsoft Teams admin center and associated PowerShell controls, including: ... Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.

claims.claim: Teams Communications Administrator can manage meeting policies through Teams admin center and PowerShell.
claims.quote: | Teams Communications Administrator | Manage calling and meetings features within the Teams service. | Manage meetings, including meeting policies, configurations, and conference bridges.

claims.claim: No separate role requirement is stated for MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams Administrator permissions; read using-admin-roles, both parameter sections in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and MC1532253. No parameter-specific role stated.

claims.claim: Setting MeetingAI to enforced off also turns transcription off.
claims.quote: if MeetingAI is set to enforced off, transcription will also be turned off

claims.claim: Turning transcription back on removes MeetingAI's enforced-off state.
claims.quote: if transcription is then turned back on, MeetingAI will no longer be enforced off.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends reviewing and updating automation, scripts, runbooks and documentation referencing the Copilot policy.
claims.quote: Review any automation or scripts that read or update the Copilot meeting policy, and update them to use MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.

claims.claim: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI must be used together.
claims.quote: This parameter must be used together with -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI. ... This parameter must be used together with -MeetingAI.

claims.claim: The current Copilot policy has UI values On, On with saved transcript required, On with transcript saved by default, and Off.
claims.quote: In the dropdown list, choose On, On with saved transcript required, On with transcript saved by default, or Off.

claims.claim: Microsoft has moved the rollout dates.
claims.quote: early December 2026 (previously mid-November) ... early January 2027 (previously late November 2026)

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot reaches the current control.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot <Enabled|EnabledWithTranscript|EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn|Disabled> is documented by the linked feature page.
claims.quote: | On | Enabled | ... | On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript | ... | On with transcript saved by default | EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn | ... | Off | Disabled |

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription reaches the page section containing the transcription control.
claims.quote: You can use the Recording & Transcription section in the Teams admin center or the -AllowTranscription parameter ... to manage your transcription policy.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the rendered table path to 'Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Transcription'. The already cited https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-transcription-captions gives the final step: 'Toggle Transcription On or Off.'

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription <$true|$false> controls whether meeting transcription is allowed.
claims.quote: ### -AllowTranscription ... Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.claim: A separate admin UI control for AllowIntelligentRecap is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowIntelligentRecap Teams admin center turn off intelligent recap policy toggle. Read intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts, Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy and Teams Premium excerpts; no admin toggle found.

claims.claim: The linked recap page documents Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false to disable recap.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.

claims.claim: The recap page says disabling intelligent recap disables it for all meetings with or without saved transcripts.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.claim: The cmdlet reference still says AllowIntelligentRecap is not fully released and has no effect, disagreeing with the recap feature page.
claims.quote: ### -AllowIntelligentRecap ... This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. Controls whether Intelligent Recap is allowed for the user's meetings.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access reaches the Work IQ access toggle.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global enables tenant Work IQ access to real-time transcripts.
claims.quote: When set to true, agents and apps can access real-time transcripts through Work IQ. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default.
claims.quote: The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can. It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.claim: EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess requires the latest Teams PowerShell module version.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet give the complete admin navigation path for the replacement MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI settings.
claims.quote: Searched: MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI; MeetingAI TranscriptionWithMeetingAI Teams admin center licensing. Read copilot-teams-transcription, both cmdlet parameter sections and meeting-transcript-api-access; replacement path not given on Learn.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy accepts -MeetingAI values EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride, DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride and DisabledNoOverride.
claims.quote: ### -MeetingAI ... Possible values are: ... EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride ... DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride ... DisabledNoOverride

claims.claim: The same command accepts -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI values EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride, DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride and EnabledNoOverride.
claims.quote: ### -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI ... Possible values are: ... EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride ... DisabledAllowOrganizerOverride ... EnabledNoOverride

claims.claim: The Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference lists only Enabled and EnabledWithTranscript for Copilot, unlike the four values on the feature page.
claims.quote: ### -Copilot ... Possible values are: ... Enabled ... EnabledWithTranscript

claims.claim: The recap page says related Teams settings become unavailable when intelligent recap is disabled.
claims.quote: Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved, and the related settings are unavailable in Teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not detailed how AllowIntelligentRecap interacts with MeetingAI.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams MeetingAI AllowIntelligentRecap interaction. Read Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy sections for both parameters, intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts and MC1532253; no explicit interaction documented.
